$comment: The canonical pattern taxonomy. Pattern ids are the only valid `pattern:<id>` review keys and the only values write_problem accepts in `patterns`. Keep ids stable: changing one orphans every review event recorded under it.

patterns.name: Arrays & Hashing
patterns.blurb: Frequency maps, set membership, prefix sums, and in-place index tricks.

patterns.name: Two Pointers
patterns.blurb: Converging or chasing indices over sorted or partitioned input.

patterns.name: Sliding Window
patterns.blurb: A contiguous range that grows and shrinks while maintaining an invariant.

patterns.name: Stack & Monotonic Stack
patterns.blurb: Matching, nesting, and next-greater problems solved with LIFO order.

patterns.name: Binary Search
patterns.blurb: Halving a sorted range or a monotonic answer space.

patterns.name: Linked List
patterns.blurb: Pointer surgery: reversal, cycle detection, merging, fast and slow runners.

patterns.name: Trees (DFS & BFS)
patterns.blurb: Recursive and level-order traversal, subtree properties, and BST invariants.

patterns.name: Tries
patterns.blurb: Prefix trees for word lookup, autocomplete, and wildcard matching.

patterns.name: Heap / Priority Queue
patterns.blurb: Top-k selection, streaming medians, and scheduling by smallest or largest.
patterns.typicalComplexity: O(n log k) time, O(k) space

patterns.name: Backtracking
patterns.blurb: Exhaustive search with pruning: subsets, permutations, and constraint placement.

patterns.name: Graphs (DFS & BFS)
patterns.blurb: Traversal, connected components, grids as graphs, and cycle detection.

patterns.name: Union-Find
patterns.blurb: Disjoint sets with path compression for connectivity and merging queries.

patterns.name: Topological Sort
patterns.blurb: Ordering a DAG by dependencies with Kahn's algorithm or DFS finishing order.

patterns.name: Shortest Paths
patterns.blurb: Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, and BFS on weighted or unweighted graphs.

patterns.name: 1-D Dynamic Programming
patterns.blurb: Linear state over a sequence: climbing stairs, house robber, coin change.

patterns.name: 2-D Dynamic Programming
patterns.blurb: Grid or two-sequence state: edit distance, LCS, unique paths.
patterns.typicalComplexity: O(n·m) time, O(n·m) or O(min(n, m)) space

patterns.name: Greedy
patterns.blurb: Locally optimal choices with an exchange argument that makes them globally optimal.
patterns.typicalComplexity: O(n log n) time, usually from a sort

patterns.name: Intervals
patterns.blurb: Sorting by start or end to merge, insert, or count overlaps.
patterns.typicalComplexity: O(n log n) time, O(n) space

patterns.name: Math & Geometry
patterns.blurb: Number theory, matrix rotation, spiral traversal, and arithmetic edge cases.

patterns.name: Bit Manipulation
patterns.blurb: XOR tricks, bit counting, and masks as sets.
patterns.typicalComplexity: O(1) or O(log n) per operation

patterns.name: Data Structure Design
patterns.blurb: LRU cache, min stack, iterators: composing structures to hit per-operation targets.
patterns.typicalComplexity: O(1) per operation is usually the target
